author: (Guilding, 1834)

note.en: A tusk shell that lives buried in sand, with INBio specimens from 2500 m southeast of Punta Mona (7.5 m) and near the Sixaola river mouth. Empty shells wash up. Size is approximate.
note.es: Un colmillo de mar que vive enterrado en la arena, con ejemplares de INBio a 2500 m al sureste de Punta Mona (7.5 m) y cerca de la desembocadura del río Sixaola. Las conchas vacías llegan a la orilla. El tamaño es aproximado.

evidence: GBIF: 2 INBio specimens, Punta Mona and Sixaola river mouth

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio specimens and others), Gandoca to Limón
Robinson & Montoya 1987, Los moluscos marinos de la Costa Atlántica de Costa Rica, Revista de Biología Tropical 35(2)

recWhy: INBio specimens at Punta Mona and Sixaola river mouth.
